scope: Read-only review of the public acceptance preparation plan against the frozen R4/R6/R7/R8/R9/R12 requirements and the corrected public integration map. This is preparation evidence only: it does not freeze a source interface, authorize implementation, launch a Builder, mutate product/tests/resources/Git, or accept public CODE.
verdict: The plan has the right nine acceptance groups and correctly separates schema, retained-byte, filesystem, CI and human evidence. Before it is used as the public implementation acceptance checklist, it needs explicit observable cases for the closed error/context contracts, fixed input and bundle cap precedence, the retained installer all-exits matrix, exact raw prefix/install order, resource-origin lineage, clarified input-directory grammar, and normalized/raw evidence-strength refusals. One phrase about copying the raw bundle must also be clarified to mean the canonical manifest plus declared object bodies rather than an archive or directory copy.
strengths: The five leaves, exact success-data shapes, fixed output families, path-key rule and handoff no-body-copy rule follow R7/map corrections.
Resource loading, strict primitive checks, ordinary input admission, identity binding, six-state replay, retained paths, peak simulation, evidence strength and zero-egress are all represented.
The plan preserves the separation between schema validity, retained-byte derivation, local fixtures, remote CI and human/real-data gates.

findings.contract_basis: R7/R8/R9 define six public semantic codes with closed reason/details, TARGET_INELIGIBLE blockers, exact limit contexts, CONFLICT contexts, R8 I/O details, exit code 2 and lineage/cleanup precedence.
missing_cases: Each JSON/document/binding/state/not-ready/target-ineligible code with every applicable reason/context shape, including bounded pointers and path-sorted blockers.
CODE_PROOF_LIMIT_EXCEEDED for /input, /request, /bundle, /intent, /observation, /config, /handoffs/<index> and /output with exact limit_name, limit and observed fields.
CODE_PROOF_CONFLICT context versus STATE_INVALID/NOT_READY/TARGET_INELIGIBLE, and lineage WORK_PATH_UNSAFE overriding semantic, operation or cleanup errors.
R8 phase/group/reason/operation/errno/prior fields with no raw path/parser/syscall text, plus exit code 2 for every refusal.
findings.required_update: Add a dedicated closed-error acceptance group with exact envelope, details and precedence assertions; keep success-schema validation separate from error validation.

findings.plan_area: Independent acceptance group 2 and install group 7
findings.contract_basis: R10/R11 require raw request/observe cap-1/equal/cap+1, bounded cap+1 observed counts, oversized malformed JSON before decode, whitespace-heavy input, lowered saved caps, and canonical bundle cap domain/pointer /bundle.
missing_cases: Request 65536-byte and observe 1048576-byte raw admissions at cap-1/equal/cap+1, including malformed oversized JSON receiving the raw cap error before decode.
A valid raw input within fixed admission cap whose lowered max_request_bytes/max_intent_bytes/max_observation_bytes fails after canonical serialization, with no installation.
Canonical manifest bundle cap-1/equal/cap+1 and hard-cap malformed overflow, with max_bundle_bytes at /bundle and no directory/output mutation.
findings.required_update: Record exact bytes-read semantics (cap+1 prefix only), error pointers/limits/observed values, and zero-install assertions for every deterministic cap refusal.

findings.contract_basis: R6/R8 require phase-aware lineage checks and cleanup across short/zero writes, link/mkdir/post-create failures, fsync/unlink/close failures, interruption, temporary replacement/disappearance and final late arrival.
missing_cases: One-byte short writes and zero-progress writes with owned temporary cleanup and preserved IO_ERROR.
Link raises with final absent and with a distinct final appearing; link success followed by identity/lineage failure; EEXIST never adopted even with equal bytes.

Temporary inode disappearance/replacement, mode/link-count changes, temp unlink failure, file fsync failure, directory fsync failure after verified cleaned prefix, and close failure while closing remaining descriptors.
mkdir raises with name absent/present, post-mkdir stat/open failure before ownership, parent fsync failure after verified creation, and KeyboardInterrupt/SystemExit cleanup paths.
findings.required_update: Enumerate the R8 event rows and assert retained prefix, refusal code, final lineage precedence, no foreign deletion/adoption and reverse-close behavior. Keep persistent distinct replacement identities; do not infer safety from inode-number reuse.

findings.plan_area: Observable observe outcome and independent groups 4 and 7
findings.contract_basis: R4/R5/R7 require byte-identical canonical manifest bundle.json before body completion, OID-sorted body prefixes including empty prefix, observation last, no fabricated inventory and valid-prefix-only repair.
missing_cases: Raw observe with request+intent only, then bundle.json installed byte-identically before bodies; status reports pending_raw_bundle with exact missing list.
Empty, partial and complete OID-sorted object prefixes, including all bodies present with observation absent; status missing order is exact and repeated observe installs only the missing suffix.
Non-prefix/unknown/incorrect-body families and observation without dependencies refuse as STATE_INVALID and are never adopted or repaired.
Assert that 'raw bundle copy' means canonical manifest.json bytes plus declared objects/<oid>.body files, not an archive, directory hash or unrelated input-directory copy.
findings.required_update: State the fixed install order and exact status/missing/next_action payloads for each pending raw state.

findings.plan_area: Independent resource-loading group 1 and retained-path group 5/6
findings.contract_basis: R6/R8 require a closed installed resource set, filesystem origin, exact profile/schema bytes, output/resource disjointness and resource lineage checks through exceptional/final exits.
missing_cases: Source-layout and wheel origins with changed/missing/undeclared schema, profile hash/shape mismatch, non-filesystem origin and external resolver denial.
Resource origin equal to/inside output namespace, resource ancestor/symlink/type/mode/link-count replacement and changed resource bytes during final verification.
Resource checks surviving a semantic failure, installer failure and normal success, with WORK_PATH_UNSAFE/resource_origin or resource_hash/resource_shape precedence as specified.
findings.required_update: Make origin identity, disjointness and all-exits resource reread cases explicit rather than relying on the general loading statement.

findings.contract_basis: R2 repair clarification separates raw input-directory spelling from output batch grammar: components may contain Unicode, spaces, dot/underscore/hyphen; exact dot/dot-dot, slash/backslash/control and lexical aliases remain forbidden.
missing_cases: Positive canonical roots .work/a, .work/input.v1, .work/_input, .work/-input, .work/input_, .work/input-, .work/.input and nested Unicode/space components.
Negative .work, .work/, repeated/trailing slashes, exact . and .. components, backslash, C0/C1/DEL, U+2028/U+2029 and path alias/symlink cases.
findings.required_update: Add these schema/CLI admission cases and assert that output batch-id grammar is not applied to input directory components.

findings.contract_basis: R7 distinguishes normalized evidence from raw-only derivation, unverified hosting/source association, whole-set handoff eligibility, exact blockers and unchanged legacy CLI behavior.
missing_cases: Normalized observation config/handoff attempts return NOT_READY/raw_evidence_required where appropriate; normalized missing/inaccessible/unavailable statuses preserve exact eligibility and blockers.
Source association remains explicitly unverified; required hosting assertion, incomplete target set, missing, unsafe and unsupported-source blockers are path-sorted and do not echo unbound selectors.

Real installed entry point preserves existing legacy command/help/error behavior while new leaves use the existing outer envelope and never import operator/admin workflows or subprocess/Git/network paths.
findings.required_update: Add exact state/error and legacy-regression assertions, alongside the existing zero-egress instrumentation.

clarification_not_contradiction: The phrase 'Raw observation copies the exact input bundle bytes' is ambiguous against R4/R11. Define it as a byte-identical canonical bundle.json manifest plus each declared retained object body; do not imply an archive, whole-directory copy or unrelated lexical-directory hash.
next_step: Amend the preparation plan with these explicit cases before using it to review a public implementation. Keep the amendment separate from the future source allowlist, resource acceptance and implementation dispatch.
stop: STOP: no implementation, launch, test run, Git action, network action or acceptance decision was performed.
